svg.title: A path tracer converging
svg.desc: A glossy sphere, a matte one and a glowing red one hovering above a dark mirror floor, path traced and drawn as characters. The picture starts as speckle and settles into shaded spheres with their reflections below them as samples accumulate, the red glow tinting its neighbour. Then the camera glides to a new view, the picture turns to noise while it moves, and accumulation starts over.
